propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: The prototype will not include transcription or diarization - input is already speaker-labelled and timestamped (speaker name, timestamp, transcript text)

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: Transcript text must be converted into claims/propositions before embedding, with one fact per proposition

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: Each proposition should have all context filled in so it makes sense independently (e.g., 'Yash is responsible for the claim schema' or 'the claim schema is due Friday')

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: For the prototype: claim index only, transcript through pointers (store meeting ID and line range in proposition, fetch from Postgres when needed), meeting index deferred.

propositions.speaker: Rishita
propositions.text: UI should show answer first, then 'source' with expandable transcript lines underneath generated claims to demonstrate provenance during demos.

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Meeting index deferred until next semester; no exact date promised due to existing work priorities.

propositions.speaker: Tejasva
propositions.text: Embedding model research: bge-small (384 dimensions) is easier to run; gte-base and nomic (~768 dimensions) do slightly better on retrieval benchmarks but may slow the pipeline.

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: Extraction accuracy is the biggest failure point in the pipeline - if LLM changes one word, vector database stores something that wasn't actually said.

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Embedding model cannot run on Nitro due to GPU memory constraints (4GB 3050, LLM already uses most of the memory)

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Use local embedding provider instead of OpenAI endpoint to maintain self-hosted nature for demo/guide review

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: Keep embedding provider behind an interface for model flexibility

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Embeddings will run on a separate machine (prototype: Sahil's Mac; demo: same approach)

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Frontend should show processing status (processing, completed, failed) because extraction takes too long to be synchronous

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Nitro provides approximately 20 tokens/second with tools enabled, meaning a one-hour meeting requires ~15 minutes of GPU time

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Implement background job for extraction instead of synchronous processing

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: The prototype will use 60-second chunks for extraction; can change later if extraction quality is bad.

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: A small context header (meeting name, participants, discussion before chunk) will be sent to the extraction model but NOT embedded in vectors.

propositions.speaker: Tejasva
propositions.text: Retrieval uses two-tier approach: SQL for structured questions (who owns payment API?, what's due Friday?) and vector search for open-ended semantic questions (why did we choose Postgres?).

propositions.speaker: Tejasva
propositions.text: A small LLM classification call will decide whether a query is structured or semantic.

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: The semantic side uses hybrid search: BM25 plus vector search with combined rankings.

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: A reranker is deferred and will not be built immediately.

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Sahil will handle the API contract part for the job status endpoint.

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: Embedding should represent the claim/proposition text, not meeting metadata; otherwise vectors become similar for the wrong reason.

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Hybrid search approach with reranker explicitly deferred until golden evaluation set exists

propositions.speaker: Tejasva
propositions.text: Postgres with pgvector chosen over Qdrant/Chroma to keep claims and vectors in same database, avoiding sync issues between separate systems

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: React/Vite/TypeScript frontend + Node/Express backend stack with Tailwind CSS

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Python service for embedding model with HTTP endpoint only (not splitting entire backend)

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: pgvector validated at prototype scale only; will revisit if scaling beyond few thousand to ten thousand claims

propositions.speaker: Tejasva
propositions.text: Claims have owner, meeting, timestamp, type, validity fields (not just vectors)

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Golden evaluation set required before reranker can be properly evaluated

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Sahil owns ingestion, transcript parsing, chunking, queue, Nitro hosting, and deployment

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: Yash owns extraction, prompt, proposition schema, tool calling, and testing model outputs

propositions.speaker: Tejasva
propositions.text: Tejasva owns database and retrieval (schema, pgvector, hybrid search, query routing)

propositions.speaker: Prakrati
propositions.text: Prakrati owns upload and meeting pages (meeting list, transcript view, processing state)

propositions.speaker: Rishita
propositions.text: Rishita owns Q&A side and citations

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: Yash will send the final claim schema field list by Friday, 2026-09-11

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Frontend should use fake JSON until backend API is ready; do not call model proxy directly from frontend
Claim schema must be finalized before database table can be finalized
Backend API must exist before frontend can properly connect; currently using fake JSON in the meantime
Missing evaluation set - no test data to prove retrieval or reranker improvements
Internal review is scheduled for late October (exact date not determined)

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: Evaluation set will be discussed on Thursday's agenda to assign ownership

propositions.speaker: Yash
propositions.text: Yash will send the schema fields by Friday.

propositions.speaker: Sahil
propositions.text: The review should demonstrate end-to-end flow: transcript input → proposition output → question asked → answer returned with source line.
